p6_b0.ocr: The data presented in the table provides an insightful analysis of the reaction kinetics under varying experimental conditions, specifically focusing on the influence of temperature and pH after post-treatment (PT) on reaction times. The experiments were conducted using three distinct mediums—U-1, U-2, and U-3—each characterized by unique concentrations and temperatures that may significantly affect biochemical processes.

p6_b1.ocr: Notably, the recorded reaction times serve as a critical metric for evaluating the efficiency of each medium under the specified conditions. In this context, the temperature and pH after PT are essential variables, as they can alter the reaction rate and the overall behavior of the system.

p6_b4.ocr: This comprehensive analysis enables a better understanding of the underlying mechanisms governing the reactions, thereby informing future experiments and applications in the field.
